# Developer marketplace API v3 — operations

9 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `marketplace.charge` — **Create a new wallet charge** — `POST /marketplace/billing/charges` (write, location)
- `marketplace.delete-charge` — **Delete a wallet charge** — `DELETE /marketplace/billing/charges/{chargeId}` (write, location)
- `marketplace.get-charges` — **Get all wallet charges** — `GET /marketplace/billing/charges` (read, location)
- `marketplace.get-installer-details` — **Get Installer Details** — `GET /marketplace/app/{appId}/installations` (read, agency/location)
  Fetches installer details for the authenticated user.
- `marketplace.get-rebilling-config-for-app` — **Get rebilling config for an app subscription and usage plans** — `GET /marketplace/app/{appId}/rebilling-config/location/{locationId}` (read, location, deprecated)
  DEPRECATED.
- `marketplace.get-specific-charge` — **Get specific wallet charge details** — `GET /marketplace/billing/charges/{chargeId}` (read, location)
- `marketplace.has-funds` — **Check if account has sufficient funds** — `GET /marketplace/billing/charges/has-funds` (read, location)
- `marketplace.migrate-connection` — **Migrate external authentication connection** — `POST /marketplace/external-auth/migration` (write, location)
  Migrates an external authentication connection credentials (basic or oauth2) for a specific app and location.
- `marketplace.uninstall-application` — **Uninstall an application** — `DELETE /marketplace/app/{appId}/installations` (write, agency/location)
  Uninstalls an application from your company or a specific location.
